title: Abstract Classes
description: Define base classes that cannot be instantiated.

data.text: An **abstract class** is a class that cannot be instantiated directly. It serves as a base class for derived classes and can contain both abstract and concrete members.

data.title: Abstract Class
Key Takeaways
points: Can have abstract and concrete members
Derived classes must implement abstract members
data.takeaway: Abstract classes provide a common base with some shared implementation.
